BannerlordCoopCampaign v0.3.1 — Changelog


Added


* Added a filter to the troop selection screen, making it easier to find specific troops in the list.



Fixed



* Fixed an issue that could prevent the host from starting a battle.
* Fixed a crash caused by ordering a formation to face the enemy.
* Fixed a crash that occurred while loading an external siege on one fortress map.
* Fixed an issue that reset loot after attacking a riderless horse or an unidentified object.
* Fixed errors in weapon skill experience gains.
* Fixed the displayed throwing weapon quantity in field battles when a perk increased the ammunition amount.
